feature: Certified adaptive Loft Refit through SDK and document preparation
native_reference: Saved public Rhino 8.32 SDK and document records; immutable capture sources
legacy_thresholds: Existing 1e-9 checks remain; previously documented correction/curved/subdivision records retain 1e-8.
comparison: All newly admitted Loft records also require a complete polynomial surface bound within requested refit tolerance. One V correspondence covers every U control row. Separate U-basis and refinement reserves include rounded edits; the matching-knot shortcut uses an exact rational de Boor perturbation bound.
limits: Generic adaptive preparation requires at least two open regular profiles, tolerance below endpoint chords and an angle at most pi/2.
Closed smooth profiles, mixed open/closed sets, resource exhaustion and unresolved final source proofs still decline without document mutation.
Geometric certificates do not establish topology or identical Rhino control nets.

certificate_preservation.method: Retain the proved original-source error. Certify a complete piecewise affine image bound from the prior fit to the final shared-basis curve; subtract the source bound with downward rounding. Both costs fit the original tolerance. Unproved composition falls back to the direct original-source search.
certificate_preservation.source_and_shared_basis_test: An identical control net with knots shifted by about 2e-16 previously lost its known source correspondence. The complete prior-to-final pointwise bound is at most 2.6714743528704507e-16.
